notes.value: Les pass donnent accès au parc pendant la saison 2026, avec les activités en illimité et un seul accès par visite à une aventure au choix : accrobranche, paintball ou Waterjump. Ils sont vendus uniquement aux caisses du parc et ne sont valables que pour la saison 2026.

The passes provide park access during the 2026 season, with unlimited activities and one adventure per visit, chosen from treetop courses, paintball or Waterjump. They are sold only at the park ticket desks and are valid for the 2026 season only.

Die Pässe ermöglichen während der Saison 2026 den Parkbesuch mit unbegrenzten Aktivitäten und einem Abenteuer pro Besuch: Kletterparcours, Paintball oder Waterjump. Sie werden ausschließlich an den Parkkassen verkauft und gelten nur für die Saison 2026.

Los pases dan acceso al parque durante la temporada 2026, con actividades ilimitadas y una aventura por visita, a elegir entre los circuitos en los árboles, paintball o Waterjump. Se venden únicamente en las taquillas del parque y solo son válidos para la temporada 2026.

I pass danno accesso al parco durante la stagione 2026, con attività illimitate e una sola avventura per visita, a scelta tra percorsi sugli alberi, paintball e Waterjump. Sono venduti esclusivamente alle casse del parco e valgono solo per la stagione 2026.

De passen geven toegang tot het park tijdens het seizoen 2026, met onbeperkte activiteiten en één avontuur per bezoek: boomklimparcoursen, paintball of Waterjump. Ze zijn uitsluitend aan de parkkassa’s verkrijgbaar en alleen geldig voor het seizoen 2026.

Karnety zapewniają wstęp do parku w sezonie 2026, nielimitowane korzystanie z aktywności oraz jedną przygodę na wizytę: park linowy, paintball lub Waterjump. Sprzedawane są wyłącznie w kasach parku i obowiązują tylko w sezonie 2026.

Os passes dão acesso ao parque durante a temporada 2026, com atividades ilimitadas e uma aventura por visita, à escolha entre arborismo, paintball ou Waterjump. São vendidos apenas nas bilheteiras do parque e válidos exclusivamente para a temporada 2026.

officialBookingChannels.question: Ou réserver mon Pack Journée ?
officialBookingChannels.quote: Vous pouvez réserver votre aventure directement sur internet lors de l’achat du pack ou bien la réserver directement aux caisses du parc.
officialBookingChannels.supports: Adventure reservation possible online during pack purchase or at park cash desks.
officialBookingChannels.doesNotSupport: This sentence does not state that the 31/34/26/20/25 EUR amounts are identical online and at the cash desks. It is not a channel-specific price table.
officialBookingChannels.marketingButtons: Réservez votre aventure and Réservez votre activité link to booking, but do not explicitly qualify the tariff amounts.
officialBookingChannels.cgv: CGV regulate internet ticket sales and say published prices are EUR including tax. They do not pair the five 2026 amounts with a channel, contain inherited 2017 effect/age wording, and cannot establish channel equality.

renderedOfficialTicketing.method: Normal public page navigation and passive rendering only. No button click, product selection, cart, login, checkout, purchase, direct internal request or stored browser profile.
renderedOfficialTicketing.visualReview: Whole screenshot reviewed: online reservation 2026 page and Under maintenance sign. Both DOM frames independently return the same maintenance message.
renderedOfficialTicketing.result: No product list or price was displayed. Maintenance prevents fresh verification of the operator’s online amounts. No alternate/internal endpoint, authentication or bypass attempted.
renderedOfficialTicketing.causeLimit: Maintenance is observed; a seasonal closure cause is not established.

source.scope: Public displayed product page only, no selections or transaction

resellerObservation.declaredRole: The public page calls Funbooker an official ticket reseller; this is its own statement, not independent verification of the commercial agreement.
resellerObservation.scopeText: One main activity of 2 hours chosen among Waterjump, paintball or accrobranche, plus other activities.
resellerObservation.interpretation: A separate public reseller offer is visibly advertised below the 31/34 reference amounts. It does not prove the operator’s own online price or a cash-desk price. No booking availability was tested after the displayed season.

outcome.recommendedEvidenceTreatment: Keep the five amounts as official 2026 published prices with channel unspecified. Preserve separate cash-desk-only qualification for the two passes. Do not relabel the five amounts as both online and guichet from the available evidence.
